content.snl: thm-hyp(list-partial(Type.judge(@F, Analysis.PFun), Type.judge(list-partial(@a, @b), Real), $#0 < #1$(a, b), Analysis.contOnIcc(F, a, b)), Logic.exists-typed(@m, Real, Logic.and(Set.mem(m, Icc(a, b)), Analysis.minPoint(F, m))))
content.markdown: A function continuous on `[a, b]` attains a minimum and a maximum at points of `[a, b]`. Attainment, not merely boundedness, is the content: `x ↦ x` on `(0, 1)` is bounded and attains neither bound, and `x ↦ 1/x` on `(0, 1]` is not even bounded. Boundedness follows as a corollary.
